title_vi: Các cách giảm độ trễ hay dùng, và vì sao phải đo trước

related.reason_vi: Các con số độ trễ nên biết giúp ước khúc nào dài trước khi đo.
Năm cách cải thiện hiệu năng API trùng nhiều cách với bài này.

claims.evidence: PostgreSQL's index chapter and RFC 9110 read from local clones; index and compression measured on PostgreSQL 16.15 and Python 3.13.16 gzip.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson (Markdown to HTML, optional sections open, 16 px side gutters) at each width: no horizontal overflow of the page or of any table; figure drawn by scripts/figures (viewBox width 320, smallest font 15 px) shown at 13.5 px effective at 320 px and 15 px at 375 px; every SVG text box inside the viewBox. python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser passed. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: An index lets the database find and retrieve specific rows much faster, but indexes add overhead to the database system as a whole and should be used sensibly.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of postgres/postgres at commit 45fc51fcbf4534ea2f6f85e36f8155dbd5ba9851, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: Content codings allow a representation to be compressed without losing information; gzip is a registered content coding.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of httpwg/httpwg.github.io at commit 03f35d852e7b64668ab08fda1a8076d6d44d17ae, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: On PostgreSQL 16.15, counting one customer's orders in a 200,000-row table took 11-13 ms with a Seq Scan and 1.3-2.1 ms after an index (Bitmap Index Scan), same result 2001; creating the index took about 105 ms; inserting 200,000 rows took 0.43-0.59 s without an index and 1.4-1.7 s with an index on a random text column (three runs).
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one virtual machine: PostgreSQL 16.15 throwaway cluster, psql timing.

claims.claim_vi: A 208,881-byte repetitive JSON array compressed with gzip level 6 to 17,720 bytes (8.5%) in about 1.5 ms and decompressed in 0.24 ms; level 9 gave 17,336 bytes in about 4.5 ms; random bytes of the same size grew to 208,964 bytes.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one virtual machine: Python 3.13.16 gzip module, mean of 20 runs.

claims.claim_vi: Strategies to reduce latency: database indexing, caching, load balancing, CDN, async processing, data compression.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Một khung bốn bước đo-chọn-đo lại-ghi giá, một khung sáu cách kèm khúc mỗi cách cắt, một khung cái giá. Gộp bộ nhớ đệm và cân bằng tải vào một thẻ để vừa slide.
source_deviations: Source opens with a figure on revenue lost to latency; it is dropped for lack of a source to check it.
Source's title says five strategies but lists six; the lesson keeps six and links each to the part of latency it cuts.
The lesson adds measurements of indexing and compression and the cost of each.
A CDN hit on a cacheable response skips the origin's work too, not only the network; the check question is set on a per-user (private) page so that only the network part is left for the CDN.
